intended_object: The upper unitriangular block matrix [[1, a], [0, 1]] (with square block a over a ring R), as a unit of the matrix ring indexed by ι ⊕ ι — one of the elementary factors in the Whitehead factorization of diag(g, g⁻¹). Inferred from docstring and module doc.
explanation: The value is fromBlocks 1 a 0 1, i.e. [[1, a],[0, 1]], and the inverse fromBlocks 1 (-a) 0 1 is correct over any (possibly noncommutative) ring. Ring is required for negation, and Fintype/DecidableEq for the matrix ring structure. The square block with a single index type is what the Whitehead factorization needs. A rectangular version (indexed by m ⊕ n) would be a minor extension, not a needed generalization. Mathlib has no general block-unitriangular unit definition; it only has related block-invertibility results and the 2×2 scalar analogue. So the definition is faithful.
